topic: K-Stick and the Self-Checkout That Scans Him
hook_text: Unexpected item in the bagging area!
facebook_caption: K-Stick went shopping for an apple and somehow became the unexpected item! 😂
youtube_description: K-Stick tries a simple self-checkout, but the machine has a very unusual idea of what belongs in the bagging area. A quick, family-friendly stickman comedy reel.

scenes.story_text: K-Stick confidently scans an apple and gives a thumbs-up as the kiosk beeps.
The kiosk flashes: "Unexpected item in bagging area!" K-Stick checks the bag, but it is empty.
K-Stick slowly steps away, and the kiosk suddenly says: "Please place K-Stick in the bagging area."
K-Stick gasps, then places only his red cap in the bag; the kiosk proudly says: "Thank you for your purchase!"
